hints.title: Dot Separated Revision Comparison
hints.text: Split or parse version numbers by periods. Missing trailing revision chunks implicitly evaluate to numeric zero.

hints.title: Dual Pointer Chunk Parsing
hints.text: Iterate across both strings using two index pointers. Convert each revision segment up to the next dot into an integer to ignore leading zeros.

hints.title: Earliest Discrepancy Return
hints.text: Compare integer values chunk by chunk. If revision one is smaller return minus one, if larger return one. If all match until exhaustion return zero.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N + M) time and O(N + M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing as raw strings fails on multi-digit revision components and ignores leading zero equivalence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Splitting revisions into integer vectors consumes O(N + M) space and runs in a clean single linear comparison loop.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle uneven revision lengths by padding shorter versions with virtual zeros.
